code:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as 用户
    participant Script as 管理脚本
    participant Docker as Docker 容器
    participant Gazebo as Gazebo
    participant Bridge as ros_gz_bridge
    participant RSP as robot_state_publisher
    participant SLAM as slam_toolbox
    participant Teleop as teleop
    participant RViz as rviz2

    User->>Script: ./turtlebot3_simulations.sh start
    Script->>Docker: docker run (创建容器)
    Docker-->>User: 容器运行中

    User->>Script: ./turtlebot3_simulations.sh build
    Script->>Docker: colcon build --symlink-install
    Docker-->>Script: 编译完成

    User->>Script: ./turtlebot3_simulations.sh turtlebot3_world
    Script->>Gazebo: gz_sim.launch.py (Server)
    Script->>Gazebo: gz_sim.launch.py (Client/GUI)
    Gazebo-->>Bridge: 加载 world 文件

    Script->>RSP: robot_state_publisher.launch.py
    RSP->>Bridge: 发布 /robot_description
    RSP->>Bridge: 发布 /tf_static (静态变换)

    Script->>Bridge: spawn_turtlebot3.launch.py
    Bridge->>Gazebo: create 节点 (生成机器人)
    Bridge->>Bridge: parameter_bridge (加载桥接配置)

    Gazebo-->>Bridge: 传感器数据 (Gazebo 原生格式)
    Bridge-->>Bridge: 格式转换 (Gazebo ROS2)
    Bridge-->>SLAM: /scan (LaserScan)
    Bridge-->>SLAM: /odom (Odometry)
    Bridge-->>SLAM: /tf (TFMessage)

    Note over SLAM: Lifecycle: Unconfigured -> Configuring -> Inactive -> Active

    User->>Script: ros2 launch slam_toolbox online_sync_launch.py
    Script->>SLAM: sync_slam_toolbox_node (Lifecycle Node)
    SLAM->>SLAM: TRANSITION_CONFIGURE
    SLAM->>SLAM: TRANSITION_ACTIVATE
    SLAM-->>SLAM: 开始建图

    User->>Teleop: 启动键盘控制
    Teleop-->>Bridge: /cmd_vel (TwistStamped)
    Bridge-->>Gazebo: 速度指令 机器人移动

    User->>RViz: 启动可视化
    RViz-->>SLAM: 订阅 /map
    RViz-->>Bridge: 订阅 /scan, /odom, /tf
    RViz-->>User: 显示建图结果
